metadata.name: twinyield
metadata.description: TwinYield core program (Treasury + Market + token mint authority + harvest) for FOGO

accounts.name: user_atoken_ata
docs: The claimer's YT (aToken) token account — its balance is the accrual base.

accounts.name: yt_position
docs: Per-holder accrual checkpoint. Created on first claim/mint.

accounts.name: treasury_base_ata
docs: Treasury's base ATA — holds the retained yield.

accounts.name: recipient_base_ata
docs: Where the claimed gFOGO is delivered.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone can call; gets the bounty share.

accounts.name: treasury_base_ata
docs: Treasury holds the surplus.

accounts.name: caller_base_ata
docs: Caller's base ATA — receives the bounty share.

accounts.name: platform_base_ata
docs: Platform's base ATA — receives the platform share.

accounts.name: pool_base_ata
docs: Rebalance pool's base ATA — receives the pool share. Must be owned
by the configured `rebalance_pool` pubkey.

accounts.name: treasury_config
docs: Treasury config — must already exist, and its `admin` must match
the signer. This prevents anyone from racing to call
`initialize_market` between deploy and the legitimate deployer's
init call.

accounts.name: platform
docs: Platform / fee recipient pubkey. Stored verbatim.

accounts.name: price_oracle
docs: content validated by `read_oracle_price`.

accounts.name: base_mint
docs: Base collateral mint (MockGFOGO on testnet, bFOGO on mainnet).
Typed so decimals are validated; its authority is external (the LST
provider), so only decimals/distinctness are checked here.

accounts.name: atoken_mint
docs: aToken (agFOGO) SPL mint. Must be solely controlled by the
treasury_config PDA: `mint_authority == treasury_config`, no freeze
authority, and zero pre-existing supply. Enforced in the handler.

accounts.name: xtoken_mint
docs: xToken (xgFOGO) SPL mint. Same constraints as `atoken_mint`.

accounts.name: price_oracle
docs: Price oracle account (MockOracle on testnet, Pyth Lazer-fed account
on mainnet). Validated at read time, not here.

accounts.name: rate_provider
docs: Rate provider account (MockGFOGORate on testnet, Brasa rate account
on mainnet). Validated at read time, not here.

accounts.name: market_authority
docs: Market authority pubkey — only this signer can call mint/redeem on
Treasury. Mirror of EVM `onlyMarket`. Typically the MarketConfig PDA.

accounts.name: yt_position
docs: YT (aToken) yield-accrual position for the recipient. Settled before the
balance grows so past yield can't be over-claimed on freshly-minted YT.

fields.name: last_time
docs: Unix timestamp (seconds) of the most recent `save_value` call.
EVM uses `uint40 block.timestamp`; on SVM we use `i64 Clock::unix_timestamp`.

fields.name: sample_interval
docs: Sample interval, in seconds. Matches `EMAStorage.sampleInterval`.

fields.name: last_value
docs: Last observed raw value, 1e18-scaled. Matches `EMAStorage.lastValue`.

fields.name: last_ema_value
docs: Last computed EMA value, 1e18-scaled. Matches `EMAStorage.lastEmaValue`.

types.name: FeeRatio
docs: Mint or redeem fee ratio. Ported from `Market.sol::FeeRatio`.
The fee actually applied is either `default_fee` (inside the stability
boundary) or `default_fee + extra_fee` (outside it), depending on the
direction — see `docs/01-protocol-overview.md::Fee model` for the table.

fields.name: default_fee
docs: Default fee, 1e18-scaled.

fields.name: extra_fee
docs: Extra fee delta, 1e18-scaled signed.

fields.name: admin
docs: Inherits Treasury's admin. Mirror of EVM `onlyOwner` on the
`update*` setters.

fields.name: rebalance_pool
docs: Rebalance pool's `PoolState` PDA — the destination of the pool's
share of harvested surplus.

fields.name: rebalance_pool_ratio
docs: 1e18-scaled fraction of surplus paid to the rebalance pool.
Mirrors `HarvestableTreasury.rebalancePoolRatio`.

fields.name: harvest_bounty_ratio
docs: 1e18-scaled fraction of surplus paid as a bounty to the harvester.
Mirrors `HarvestableTreasury.harvestBountyRatio`.

fields.name: beta
docs: aToken volatility multiple (`Treasury.beta`). Set to 0 for the
canonical TwinYield deploy.

fields.name: base_token_cap
docs: Maximum total base token deposit, in wrapped units
(`Treasury.baseTokenCap`).

fields.name: initial_mint_ratio
docs: 1e18-scaled ratio splitting the first joint mint into a/x.
Must be `0 < x < PRECISION`. Canonical value: `0.5e18`.

fields.name: ema_sample_interval
docs: EMA sample interval in seconds. Must be `>= MIN_EMA_SAMPLE_INTERVAL`.

fields.name: admin
docs: Admin pubkey. Mirror of `Market.DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` holder.

fields.name: treasury_config
docs: Pointer to the TreasuryConfig PDA this market drives.

fields.name: platform
docs: Platform / fee recipient. Mirror of `Market.platform`.

fields.name: reserve_pool
docs: Optional reserve pool (`Market.reservePool`). `Pubkey::default()` =
"not set" sentinel.

fields.name: flags
docs: Packed pause flags. See [`flags`].

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: TreasuryConfig
docs: Admin-owned, rarely-mutated configuration for the Treasury.

fields.name: admin
docs: Admin pubkey. Maps to `OwnableUpgradeable._owner` in the EVM source.

fields.name: market_authority
docs: The pubkey allowed to call mint / redeem on this treasury (mirror of
EVM `Treasury.market`, enforced by `onlyMarket`). Typically the
MarketConfig PDA.

fields.name: base_mint
docs: Base collateral mint (`Treasury.baseToken`).

fields.name: atoken_mint
docs: aToken mint (`Treasury.aToken`).

fields.name: xtoken_mint
docs: xToken mint (`Treasury.xToken`).

fields.name: price_oracle
docs: Price oracle account (`Treasury.priceOracle`).

fields.name: rate_provider
docs: Rate provider account (`Treasury.rateProvider`).

fields.name: beta
docs: aToken volatility multiple. Matches `Treasury.beta`. Set to `0` for
the canonical TwinYield deploy (fully stable aToken).

fields.name: base_token_cap
docs: Maximum allowed total base token deposit (`Treasury.baseTokenCap`).

fields.name: initial_mint_ratio
docs: 1e18-scaled ratio used to split the first joint mint into a/x.
Immutable in EVM (`Treasury.initialMintRatio`). Mirrored here.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: TreasuryRuntime
docs: Frequently-mutated treasury state. Updated on every mint/redeem.

fields.name: total_base_token
docs: Total base token held, in **unwrapped** units. Mirrors
`Treasury.totalBaseToken` exactly — the wrapped balance lives on the
Treasury's SPL ATA; this counter tracks the unwrapped equivalent.

fields.name: last_permissioned_price
docs: Last permissioned price captured by `initialize_price`. 1e18-scaled.
Mirrors `Treasury.lastPermissionedPrice`.

fields.name: ema_leverage_ratio
docs: EMA storage for the leverage ratio (`Treasury.emaLeverageRatio`).

fields.name: yt_reward_index
docs: PT/YT redesign (`docs/11-pt-yt-redesign-spec.md`): cumulative yield
reward per YT (aToken) unit, scaled by `PRECISION`. Bumped by `harvest`
(`+= surplus_w9 * PRECISION / atoken_supply_w9`). A holder's entitlement
is `balance_w9 * (yt_reward_index - reward_debt_index) / PRECISION`.

fields.name: yt_yield_reserve
docs: PT/YT redesign: wrapped 9-decimal gFOGO retained in the treasury as
unclaimed YT yield. Subtracted when computing fresh harvest surplus so
retained yield isn't double-counted; decremented by `claim_yield`.

fields.name: initialized_price
docs: Set to `true` after `initialize_price`. Mirrors the EVM
`require(lastPermissionedPrice == 0)` guard.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.

types.name: YtPosition
docs: Per-holder YT (yield-token / senior-tranche) yield-accrual position.
PT/YT redesign (`docs/11-pt-yt-redesign-spec.md`). One PDA per YT holder,
seeds `[YT_POSITION_SEED, owner]`. Tracks the reward index at the holder's
last checkpoint plus any settled-but-unclaimed yield, using the classic
MasterChef-style `reward_debt` pattern over classic SPL Token (Token-2022
transfer hooks are unavailable on FOGO — see `docs/04-fogo-environment.md`).

fields.name: owner
docs: The YT (aToken) holder this position belongs to.

fields.name: reward_debt_index
docs: `yt_reward_index` value captured at the holder's last checkpoint
(mint / redeem / claim). Yield accrues only on the delta since.

fields.name: unclaimed
docs: Settled-but-not-yet-transferred yield, wrapped 9-decimal gFOGO.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump.
